test=[[6,1,0],[4,8,9],[2,7,3]]
def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    cw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    rot180=[row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    out=[a+b for a,b in zip(grid,cw)] + [a+b for a,b in zip(ccw,rot180)]
    return out
result=transform(test)
print(result)
